title: Permanence of Indocyanine Green in axillary lymph nodes three weeks after subdermal injection in patients with Breast Carcinoma and metastatic lymph nodes: The FLUO Trial
official: Permanence of Indocyanine Green in axillary lymph nodes three weeks after subdermal injection in patients with Breast Carcinoma and metastatic lymph nodes: The FLUO Trial
summary: Main objective: Permanence of fluorescence at the level of axillary lymph nodes at 2-3 weeks after subcutaneous injection of Indocyanine Green (2.5 mg), in patients who will undergo radical axillary surgery [Time Frame: up to 3 weeks]
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Written informed consent prior to beginning any protocol specific procedure during treatment and follow up, according to regulatory requirements.
2. Age equal to or higher than 18 years
3. Patients affeted by breast cancer with cyto-histological confirmation of lymph node metastases and eligible for quadrantectomy/mastectomy combined with radical axillary surgery.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Allergy to iodium or Indocyanine Green
2. Presence of Thyroid disorders (hyperthyroidism, autoimmune thyroid adenomas)
3. Patients not eligible for radical axillary surgery
4. Patient in a state of pregnancy
5. Under the age of 18 years
6. Non-autonomous patient or in need of a legal representative
sponsor: Centro Di Riferimento Oncologico Di Aviano
